title: 第二十三章 我张小乙有化劲之姿第二十四章 意气风发
slug: 武道每日加点打更人肝成人间武圣
content_zh:
第二天上午，秦苏在演武场角落，已经练了一个半时辰的开山拳。
起势沉腰，拳随身走，十二式开山拳接连打出。
崩拳刚猛直进，劈拳势如破竹，横拳拦挡封架，每一招都打得行云流水。
明劲一成，周身筋骨浑然一体，力从地起，经腰腹传至拳锋，再没有滞涩。
之前练了半个月才摸到18点熟练度的开山拳，此刻每打一遍，都有新的体悟。
不到一个上午的功夫，秦苏凝神看向面板，开山拳的熟练度已经跳到了1920，只差最后一点，就能踏入入门。
他深吸一口气，秦苏有信心，在今天上午就将开山拳练至入门。
周围练拳的弟子见他一上午都在磨开山拳，纷纷摇了摇头。
几个老弟子凑在一起，压低了声音议论。
“这秦苏，真是本末倒置。桩功是根基，境界是根本，现在最重要的是冲明劲，现在练拳法，真的是浪费时间。”
“就是，没入明劲，拳法练得再熟，也打不出力道。
我们这些人，每天也就练一个时辰的拳法，剩下的时间全用练五行归元桩冲境界，他倒好，一上午都耗在这上面了。”
“丙下根骨，就算再努力，也赶不上张小乙，怕是破罐子破摔了吧。”
这些话秦苏现在也能听见，但是他没管，歇了半盏茶的功夫，再次练功。
演武场的另一边，张小乙也看到了这一幕，鼻子里发出一声冷哼，眼底满是不屑。
秦苏竟然蠢到这种地步，这个节骨眼上不去冲桩功大成，反倒练拳法，是最不智的算则。
武选登龙还有一个多月就开了，这是安陆县三年一度的盛事，只收明劲及以下的武者，却只针对明劲武者设榜。
这是整个大雍王朝的大日，每一个武者都会在这一天进行武选，然后角逐出登龙武者。
至于为什么没有暗劲的，因为十八岁以下的暗劲武者不会通过武选登龙，他们会直接被上面单招，这也是给明劲武者一个公平的竞争机会。
考核分两道程序，积分制排名。

第二道固定是擂台比试，赢一场积一分，输了不扣，最终按积分定名次。
第一道基础关却年年不同，有时是闯木人巷，有时是进山猎杀凶兽，没人能提前预判。
可无论考核内容怎么变，根据以往的经验，只有明劲武者才可以登龙。
登龙之后，就能得到那些各种武道门派的邀请，可以去更大的舞台修炼，冲击更高的境界。
张小乙收回目光，心里冷笑。
秦苏现在连明劲都没到，一个多月后，武选的时候肯定会被刷下来，还谈什么和自己比。
这次，他看秦苏还怎么追上来。
他不再看旁人，沉下心来，练起了五行归元桩的架势。
张小乙有一种预感，成为明劲武者，就在今日。
桩功一起，周身的气息缓缓沉淀，气血不断翻涌。
他能清晰地感觉到，那层困住他许久的薄膜，就在眼前，只差最后一点力气，就能捅破。
周围的弟子渐渐发现了不对劲。
张小乙整个人像是和大地融为了一体，气息绵长，不见半分紊乱。
就在众人纷纷侧目，低声议论的时候，张小乙突然发出一声沉喝，声震演武场。
所有人的目光瞬间都聚了过来，连正在练拳的秦苏，也望了过去。
只见张小乙缓缓打出了一整套五行归元桩。
起势、沉腰、拧转、收势，一招一式圆润流畅。
随着他的动作，发出阵阵沉闷的响声，气血沉于脏腑，劲达四肢末梢，正是明劲武者的标志。
最后一式打完，张小乙站定，气息匀净，面不改色，眼底是压抑不住的喜意。
演武场死一般的寂静，然后瞬间炸开了锅。

“破了！张小乙踏入明劲了！”
“五十三天！整整五十三天就成明劲武者了！”
“十天桩功入门，五十三天扣关明劲，这……这打破了咱们武馆的记录啊！”
content_en:
The next morning, Qin Su had been practicing Kaishan Quan for an hour and a half in the corner of the martial arts arena.
Starting from the posture, lowering the waist, the fists follow, and the twelve posture Kaishan fists are fired one after another.
The Bengquan moves forward fiercely, the splitting fist is as powerful as breaking bamboo, the horizontal fist blocks and seals the frame, and every move is executed smoothly.
Once the Ming Jin is completed, the muscles and bones of the whole body become one, and the force starts from the ground, passes through the waist and abdomen to the fist front, and there is no stagnation anymore.
It took me half a month to practice Kaishan Quan before reaching 18 points of proficiency. Now, every time I practice it, I gain new insights.
In less than a morning, Qin Su looked at the panel attentively. His proficiency in Kaishan Quan had jumped to 1920, and he was just missing the last point to get started.
He took a deep breath. Qin Su was confident that he would practice Kaishan Quan to the basic level this morning.
The boxing disciples around him shook their heads when they saw that he had been sharpening his Shanquan all morning.
Several old disciples gathered together and discussed in lowered voices.
"This Qin Su is really putting the cart before the horse. Zhuang Gong is the foundation, state is the fundamental, the most important thing now is Chong Ming Jin, practicing boxing now is really a waste of time."
"It's just that without Ming Jin, no matter how familiar your boxing skills are, you won't be able to produce powerful punches.
We people only practice boxing for an hour every day, and the rest of the time is spent practicing the Five Elements Guiyuan Zhuang Chong realm. Fortunately for him, he spent the whole morning on it. "
"Bing is so weak, no matter how hard he tries, he still can't catch up with Zhang Xiaoyi. I'm afraid he will fall apart."
Qin Su could hear these words now, but he didn't care. He took a break for half a cup of tea and practiced again.
On the other side of the martial arts arena, Zhang Xiaoyi also saw this scene, snorting coldly from his nose, his eyes full of disdain.
Qin Su was so stupid that it was the most unwise plan to practice boxing instead of mastering the punching technique at this juncture.
The Wushu Climbing Dragon Competition will start in more than a month. This is a grand event held every three years in Anlu County. Only martial artists with Ming Jin and below will be admitted, but only martial artists with Ming Jin will be ranked.
This is a great day for the entire Dayong Dynasty. Every warrior will conduct a martial arts selection on this day, and then compete to be the warrior who ascends the dragon.
As for why there are no Anjin warriors, it is because Anjin warriors under the age of 18 will not pass the martial arts selection to ascend the dragon. They will be directly attacked by the superiors. This also gives Mingjin warriors a fair chance to compete.
The assessment is divided into two procedures, and the ranking is based on points.
The second stage is fixed in the arena competition. If you win a game, you will get one point. If you lose, you will not be deducted. The final ranking will be determined by points.
The first basic level changes every year. Sometimes it involves breaking into the alley of wooden men, sometimes it involves going into the mountains to hunt ferocious beasts. No one can predict it in advance.
But no matter how the assessment content changes, based on past experience, only Mingjin warriors can ascend the dragon.
After climbing the dragon, you can get invitations from various martial arts sects, and you can practice on a bigger stage and hit a higher realm.
Zhang Xiaoyi looked away and sneered in his heart.
Qin Su doesn't even have Ming Jin now. In more than a month, he will definitely be rejected during the martial arts selection. Why should he compare with himself?
This time, he wanted to see how Qin Su could catch up.
He stopped looking at others, calmed down, and practiced the posture of the Five Elements Guiyuan Zhuang.
Zhang Xiaoyi had a premonition that he would become a Ming Jin warrior today.
As he performed the Zhuang Kung Fu, the aura throughout his body slowly settled, and his energy and blood continued to surge.
He could clearly feel that the film that had trapped him for a long time was right in front of him, and he only needed the last bit of strength to break through it.
The disciples around him gradually realized that something was wrong.
Zhang Xiaoyi's whole figure seemed to be integrated with the earth, his breath was long and there was no trace of disorder.
Just when everyone was looking sideways and talking in low voices, Zhang Xiaoyi suddenly let out a deep shout, which shook the martial arts arena.
Everyone's eyes immediately focused on him, even Qin Su, who was practicing boxing, looked over.
I saw Zhang Xiaoyi slowly playing a set of Five Elements Guiyuan stakes.
Starting from the posture, lowering the waist, twisting and closing the posture, each move is smooth and smooth.
Follow his movements, making bursts of dull sounds, the energy and blood sinking in the organs, and the strength reaching the ends of the limbs, which is the sign of a Ming Jin warrior.
After finishing the last move, Zhang Xiaoyi stood still, his breath even, his face unchanged, and his eyes filled with uncontrollable joy.
The martial arts arena was deathly silent, and then exploded in an instant.
"It's broken! Zhang Xiaoyi has stepped into Mingjin!"
"Fifty-three days! In just fifty-three days, you will become a Ming Dynasty warrior!"
"It takes ten days to get started with Zhuang Kung Fu, and fifty-three days to dunk Guan Ming Jin. This...this breaks the record of our martial arts school!"
